Backticks code block trims trailing newline inside fence and adds blank line after closing fence (issue #396)

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Foo</p><pre><code>1\n2\n</code></pre><p>Bar</p>", HtmlToMarkdownRs::ConversionOptions.new(code_block_style: 'Backticks'))
puts result.inspect
```
